policy.primaryRule: PRs are shared only by resolved autoPrGroupId in safe mode. There are zero unresolved library review candidates.
policy.equipmentSeparation: Barbell, dumbbell, cable, machine, kettlebell, band, bodyweight, and specific Other subtypes are never merged automatically.
policy.safeMode: Use autoPrGroupId. Only high-confidence groups share automatically.
policy.reviewMode: Use candidatePrGroupId/smartPrGroupId to suggest user-confirmed links.
policy.familyMode: Use movementFamilyId only for related-exercise display, never default PR records.
policy.reviewCandidatePolicy: All 2026-04-29 review candidates have been resolved as auto_merge, split_suggest_only, or split_hard. Suggestion-only groups are never used for PR aggregation.
